latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of hr-policy-generator.

- Generates comprehensive HR policy documents covering attendance, time-off, overtime, remote work, and compliance.
- Produces legal compliance checklists, exception handling frameworks, and employee communication plans.
- Customizes outputs based on company size, work arrangement, and jurisdiction.
- Supports input of current policies, employee feedback, and industry standards for tailored results.
